notes: SHORTLISTED 2026-11-13, his pick, buying (Andrew, 2026-11-13: "be an interior designer: can we pick colored clocks? not just black/gold/brown? must fit and not look weird", then, of the green and the blue-gray: "ok buying now. record how HIGH I should put the clock. wrap up."). HANG: the living room's upper-left corner, on the window wall between the stair railing and the window: its center 60 in off the floor and 48 in from the railing's corner (the top edge about 69 in, the bottom about 51 in); the screw goes at 60 in plus the distance from the clock's hanger to its center, measured on the clock (F-70). Why: a white face with large bold black numerals, black hands and a red sweep second hand in a deep green rim, the open plan's sage accent (F-68 (6)) in a darker, richer shade beside the walnut and the honey oak; 18 in reads from the sofa (14 ft), the stairs (13 ft) and the kitchen (21 ft). Read 2026-11-13 off the listing: $43.95 for Hunter Green (Navy, Red and Blue the same; delivery Sun, Nov 15, "Only 4 left in stock"), 4.4 stars (32,452), "Glass cover protects dial": glass, which F-21 bars and he took on by buying. Its own page, first behind the bot check, was read later that evening: $43.95, 4.4 stars (32,452), 3.49 lb, white dial; photo saved. rooms: the brief.
